# Libraries

```{r libraries}
# calculations
library(geomorph) # GPA 
library(shapes) # procGPA
library(tidyr) # pivot_longer

# plotting and visualization
library(ggplot2) # plots
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_light())
library(ggpubr) # ggarange

```

# Variable names

```{r var-names}

p = 21 # number of landmarks
k = 2  # number of dimensions, in this case 2 for coordinates (x, y)

# define which landmarks are connected by lines in wireframe graph
link.x <- seq(from=1, to=p-1)
link.y <- seq(from=2, to=p)
links <- cbind(link.x, link.y)

```

# EqD - Equidistant semilandmarks
Uncorrected semilandmarks are equidistant along the pixel outline. 

## GPA

```{r eqd-gpa}

inEqd = read.csv("https://zenodo.org/records/23911653/files/EqD.csv", row.names = 1, sep = ";")
colony = substr(rownames(inEqd),1,6)
colony <- gsub("KR-00", "colony", colony)
table(colony)

threeDEqd <- arrayspecs(inEqd, p, k)
dimnames(threeDEqd)[[3]] <- rownames(inEqd)
gpaEqd <- gpagen(threeDEqd, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)
xyAll <- matrix(aperm(gpaEqd$coords, c(1, 3, 2)), nrow=prod(dim(threeDEqd)[c(1,3)]))
colnames(xyAll) = c("X", "Y")
plotData = cbind(xyAll, 
                 landmark = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[1]), dim(threeDEqd)[3]),
                 specimen = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[3]), each=dim(threeDEqd)[1]))
plotMean = as.data.frame(gpaEqd$consensus) 
figAliA = ggplot(plotMean, aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_path(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_fixed() +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(plotMean)), nudge_y = 0.02) +
  geom_point(plotData, mapping=aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(plotMean, mapping=aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_void()
figAliA

```

## PCA

```{r eqd-pca}

pcaEqd <- gm.prcomp(gpaEqd$coords)
varTab <- summary(pcaEqd)$PC.summary
varExp <- data.frame(
  PC = seq_along(pcaEqd$d),
  var = as.numeric(varTab["Proportion of Variance", ])
)
figHistA = ggplot(varExp, aes(x=PC, y=var)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black", fill = "white") + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Proportion \nof variance") +
  xlim(0, 22) +
  ylim(0, 0.6)
figHistA

pcaScoresEqd <- as.data.frame(pcaEqd$x)
colnames(pcaScoresEqd) <- gsub("Comp", "PC", colnames(pcaScoresEqd))
pcaScoresEqd <- cbind(pcaScoresEqd, colony)

# create plot labels
variance <- varTab["Proportion of Variance", "Comp1"]
variance <- round(100 * variance, 1)
labelX <- paste0("PC1 (", variance, "%)")
variance <- varTab["Proportion of Variance", "Comp2"]
variance <- round(100 * variance, 1)
labelY <- paste0("PC2 (", variance, "%)")

figPcaA = ggplot(pcaScoresEqd, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = colony, color = colony)) +
  geom_point() + scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c(1:3)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = rainbow(3)) + 
  stat_ellipse() +
  labs(x = labelX, y = labelY) 
figPcaA

```

## LM

```{r eqd-lm}

gdfEqd <- geomorph.data.frame(gpaEqd, colony = colony)
lmEqd <- procD.lm(coords ~ colony, data = gdfEqd)
summary(lmEqd)

pdEqd <- pairwise(lmEqd, groups = colony)
summary(pdEqd, test.type = "dist", stat.table = TRUE)

pvEqd = morphol.disparity(f1 = lmEqd, groups = colony, data = gdfEqd, print.progress = FALSE)
pvEqd

```

# SaT - samilandmarks along tangent
Semilandmarks corrected along tangent. 

## GPA

```{r sat-gpa}

# create matrix used for sliding semilandmarks
slidingMat <- cbind(before = seq(from = 1, to = p - 2), slide = seq(from = 2, to = p -
  1), after = seq(from = 3, to = p))
slidingMat


gpaSat <- gpagen(threeDEqd, curves = slidingMat, ProcD = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)
xyAll <- matrix(aperm(gpaSat$coords, c(1, 3, 2)), nrow=prod(dim(threeDEqd)[c(1,3)]))
colnames(xyAll) = c("X", "Y")
plotData = cbind(xyAll, 
                 landmark = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[1]), dim(threeDEqd)[3]),
                 specimen = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[3]), each=dim(threeDEqd)[1]))
plotMean = as.data.frame(gpaSat$consensus) 
figAliB = ggplot(plotMean, aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_path(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_fixed() +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(plotMean)), nudge_y = 0.02) +
  geom_point(plotData, mapping=aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(plotMean, mapping=aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_void()
figAliB

```

# Distance to mean shape

```{r rho}

rhoEqd = procGPA(gpaEqd$coords)
rhoEqd = rhoEqd$rho

rhoSat = procGPA(gpaSat$coords)
rhoSat = rhoSat$rho

rhoSao = procGPA(gpaSao$coords)
rhoSao = rhoSao$rho

rhoEqd = data.frame(Semilandmarks = "EqD", rho = rhoEqd)
rhoSat = data.frame(Semilandmarks = "SaT", rho = rhoSat)
rhoSao = data.frame(Semilandmarks = "SaO", rho = rhoSao)

rho = rbind(rhoEqd, rhoSat, rhoSao)
rho$Semilandmarks  = factor(
  rho$Semilandmarks, 
  levels=c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"),
  labels=c("Equidistant", "Along tangent", "Along outline")
) 

anova = aov(rho ~ Semilandmarks, data=rho)
summary(anova)
TukeyHSD(anova, conf.level=.95)

figVA = ggplot(rho, aes(x=Semilandmarks, y=rho)) + 
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Distance to mean shape") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.04), expand = c(0, 0))
figVA

```

# Wing shape

```{r shape}

inAll = inEqd
tmp = as.data.frame(two.d.array(gpaSat$coords))
colnames(tmp) = colnames(inAll)
inAll = rbind(inAll, tmp)
inAll = rbind(inAll, inSao)

threeDAll <- arrayspecs(inAll, p, k)
dimnames(threeDAll)[[3]] <- rownames(inAll)
gpaAll <- gpagen(threeDAll, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)

semilandmarksAll <- c(rep("EqD", 90),
                      rep("SaT", 90),
                      rep("SaO", 90))

colonyAll <- substr(rownames(inAll), 1, 6)
colonyAll <- gsub("KR-00", "colony", colonyAll)

gdfAll <- geomorph.data.frame(gpaAll, colony = colonyAll, semilandmarks = semilandmarksAll)
lmAll <- procD.lm(coords ~ colony * semilandmarks, data = gdfAll)
summary(lmAll)

```

# Compare variance within and between colonies

```{r var}

pv = data.frame(
  EqD = pvEqd$Procrustes.var,
  SaT = pvSat$Procrustes.var,
  SaO = pvSao$Procrustes.var
)
pv$colony <- factor(1:nrow(pv))

pvLong <- pivot_longer(
  pv,
  cols = c(EqD, SaT, SaO),
  names_to = "Semilandmarks",
  values_to = "PV"
)
pvLong$Semilandmarks <- factor(
  pvLong$Semilandmarks,
  levels=c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"),
  labels=c("Equidistant", "Along tangent", "Along outline")
) 
figVB = ggplot(pvLong,
               aes(x = Semilandmarks, y = PV/1e-04,
                   group = colony, colour = colony)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Procrustes variance (" * 10^{-4} * ")")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = rainbow(3)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 3.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) + theme(legend.position = "top")
figVB

pd = data.frame(
  EqD = pdEqd$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdEqd$means.dist$obs)],
  SaT = pdSat$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdSat$means.dist$obs)],
  SaO = pdSao$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdSao$means.dist$obs)]
)
pd$colony <- factor(c("1-2", "1-3", "2-3"))
pdLong <- pivot_longer(
  pd,
  cols = c(EqD, SaT, SaO),
  names_to = "Semilandmarks",
  values_to = "PD"
)
pdLong$Semilandmarks <- factor(
  pdLong$Semilandmarks,
  levels=c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"),
  labels=c("Equidistant", "Along tangent", "Along outline")
) 
figVC = ggplot(pdLong,
               aes(x = Semilandmarks, y = PD,
                   group = colony, colour = colony)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Procrustes distance") +
  scale_color_manual(values = rainbow(3)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.02),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) + theme(legend.position = "top")
figVC

figV = ggarrange(figVA, figVB, figVC, labels = c("a", "b", "c"), font.label = list(size = 10, face = "bold"), ncol = 1, nrow = 3)
annotate_figure(
  figV,
  bottom = text_grob("Semilandmarks", size = 12)
)
# ggsave('figV.pdf', width = 120, height = 200, units = 'mm')
# ggsave('figV.png', width = 120, height = 200, units = 'mm')

```
